{
  "name": "loss_contrastive_tanh_advantage",
  "intuition": "Transforms the pairwise log-probability gap via tanh activation, weighted by the advantage gap, and applies a contrastive margin loss to encourage stronger separation based on relative advantage.",
  "pseudocode": "adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']\nlpw = batch['log_prob_w']\nlpl = batch['log_prob_l']\nweight = batch.get('weight', None)\ngap = lpw - lpl\ntransformed_gap = tanh(beta * gap)\nmargin = max(0, margin_val - adv_gap * transformed_gap)\nloss = weight * margin\nreturn mean(loss)",
  "hyperparams": {
    "paradigm_family": "contrastive",
    "signal_family": "advantage_gap",
    "link_family": "tanh",
    "agg_family": "mean",
    "constraint_family": "relu_margin"
  },
  "operators_used": [
    "tanh",
    "max",
    "mul",
    "sub",
    "mean"
  ],
  "implementation_hint": {
    "expects": [
      "log_prob_w",
      "log_prob_l",
      "weight",
      "advantage_gap"
    ],
    "returns": "scalar",
    "mode": "pairwise"
  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', None)\n    beta = float(extra.get('beta', 1.0))\n    margin_val = float(extra.get('margin_val', 1.0))\n    gap = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)\n    transformed_gap = ops.tanh(ops.mul(beta, gap))\n    raw_margin = ops.sub(margin_val, ops.mul(adv_gap, transformed_gap))\n    margin = ops.max(raw_margin, ops.zeros_like(raw_margin))\n    if weight is not None:\n        margin = ops.mul(margin, weight)\n    return ops.mean(margin)"
}

{
  "name": "loss_logsigmoid_000_cost_logsumexp",
  "intuition": "pairwise logsigmoid loss with shifted aggregation structure using log-sum-exp for robust summarization",
  "pseudocode": "for each pair: compute clamp(alpha*scale*(lpw-lpl) - 0.1*gap, -20, 20)\nlosses = -logsigmoid of above\naggregate = logsumexp(losses * weight) - log(sum of weights)\nreturn aggregate",
  "hyperparams": {
    "paradigm_family": "pairwise_margin",
    "signal_family": "cost_gap",
    "link_family": "logsigmoid",
    "agg_family": "logsumexp_normalized",
    "constraint_family": "clamp_stabilized"
  },
  "operators_used": [
    "logsigmoid",

    "exp",
    "log",
    "sum",
    "sub",
    "mul",
    "div",
    "maximum",
    "minimum"
  ],
  "implementation_hint": {
    "expects": [
      "log_prob_w",
      "log_prob_l",
      "weight",
      "cost_a",
      "cost_b"
    ],
    "returns": "scalar",
    "mode": "pairwise"
  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight')\n    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))\n    scale = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('scale', 1.9496803035382082))\n    cost_a = batch['cost_a']\n    cost_b = batch['cost_b']\n    gap = (cost_b - cost_a).detach()\n    x = alpha * scale * (lpw - lpl) - 0.1 * gap\n    x = ops.clamp(x, -20.0, 20.0)\n    losses = -ops.logsigmoid(x)\n    if weight is None:\n        weight = ops.ones_like(losses)\n    max_loss = ops.max(losses * weight)\n    lse = max_loss + ops.log(ops.sum(ops.exp(losses * weight - max_loss)))\n    sum_weight = ops.sum(weight)\n    loss = lse - ops.log(sum_weight)\n    return loss"
}

{
  "name": "loss_tanh_advantage_weighted",
  "intuition": "Use a pairwise loss with a tanh link function applied to the scaled log-probability gap, weighted by a normalized advantage signal to emphasize the confidence of preference differences.",
  "pseudocode": "gap = advantage_w - advantage_l\nscaled_diff = alpha * (log_prob_w - log_prob_l)\ntanh_score = tanh(scaled_diff)\nweighted_loss = weight * (1 - tanh_score) * normalize(gap)\nloss = mean(weighted_loss)",
  "hyperparams": {
    "paradigm_family": "pairwise_confidence_weighted",
    "signal_family": "advantage_gap",
    "link_family": "tanh",
    "agg_family": "mean",
    "constraint_family": "normalized_weight"
  },
  "operators_used": [
    "tanh",

    "div",
    "mean",

    "min",
    "clamp",
    "abs"
  ],
  "implementation_hint": {
    "expects": [
      "log_prob_w",
      "log_prob_l",
      "weight",
      "advantage_w",
      "advantage_l"
    ],
    "returns": "scalar",
    "mode": "pairwise"
  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))\n    adv_w = batch['advantage_w']\n    adv_l = batch['advantage_l']\n    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))\n    gap = ops.sub(adv_w, adv_l)\n    gap_mean = ops.mean(gap)\n    gap_std = ops.sqrt(ops.mean(ops.mul(ops.sub(gap, gap_mean), ops.sub(gap, gap_mean))))\n    gap_normalized = ops.div(ops.sub(gap, gap_mean), ops.add(gap_std, 1e-8))\n    scaled_diff = ops.mul(alpha, ops.sub(lpw, lpl))\n    tanh_score = ops.tanh(scaled_diff)\n    loss_per_pair = ops.mul(weight, ops.mul(ops.sub(ops.ones_like(tanh_score), tanh_score), ops.relu(gap_normalized)))\n    return ops.mean(loss_per_pair)"
}

{
  "name": "loss_pairwise_margin_entropy_advantage",
  "intuition": "Incorporate model uncertainty via entropy difference modulating an advantage-weighted margin loss to prefer confident improvements.",
  "pseudocode": "margin = clamp((log_prob_w - log_prob_l) * (advantage_w - advantage_l), -20, 20)\nentropy_diff = (entropy_l - entropy_w).clamp(min=0)\nweight_mod = sigmoid(entropy_diff)\nloss = -logsigmoid(margin) * weight_mod * weight\nreturn mean(loss)",

    "paradigm_family": "pairwise_weighted_margin",

  },

  ],
  "implementation_hint": {
    "expects": [
      "log_prob_w",
      "log_prob_l",

      "entropy_l"
    ],
    "returns": "scalar",
    "mode": "pairwise"
  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', None)\n    adv_w = batch['advantage_w']\n    adv_l = batch['advantage_l']\n    ent_w = batch.get('entropy_w', ops.zeros_like(lpw))\n    ent_l = batch.get('entropy_l', ops.zeros_like(lpl))\n\n    margin_raw = (lpw - lpl) * (adv_w - adv_l)\n    margin = ops.clamp(margin_raw, -20.0, 20.0)\n\n    entropy_diff = ops.clamp(ent_l - ent_w, 0.0, 1000.0)  # no upper clamp limit, just large positive\n    weight_mod = ops.sigmoid(entropy_diff)\n\n    loss = -ops.logsigmoid(margin)\n    if weight is not None:\n        loss = loss * weight\n    loss = loss * weight_mod\n\n    return ops.mean(loss)"
}

{
  "name": "loss_softplus_advantage_square",
  "intuition": "Instead of relying on margin-based pairwise comparisons with logsigmoid, this loss transforms the difference in log probabilities with a softplus, promoting smooth penalization of poorly ranked 'winning' sequences. It integrates the squared advantage gap as a weight, emphasizing pairs where the preference signal is stronger, capturing more nuanced preference confidence.",
  "pseudocode": "adv_sq = advantage_gap ^ 2\nscore_diff = log_prob_w - log_prob_l\nloss = softplus(-score_diff) * adv_sq * weight\nfinal_loss = mean(loss)",
  "hyperparams": {
    "paradigm_family": "pairwise_probability",
    "signal_family": "advantage_gap",
    "link_family": "softplus",
    "agg_family": "mean",
    "constraint_family": "none"
  },
  "operators_used": [
    "sub",
    "mul",
    "softplus",
    "mean",
    "pow"
  ],
  "implementation_hint": {
    "expects": [
      "log_prob_w",
      "log_prob_l",
      "weight",
      "advantage_gap"
    ],
    "returns": "scalar",
    "mode": "pairwise"
  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))\n    adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']\n    adv_sq = ops.mul(adv_gap, adv_gap)\n    score_diff = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)\n    loss_raw = ops.mul(ops.softplus(ops.neg(score_diff)), adv_sq)\n    weighted_loss = ops.mul(loss_raw, weight)\n    return ops.mean(weighted_loss)"
}
